# azion_workloads (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "azion_workloads" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `counter` (Number) The total count of workloads.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the data source.
- `results` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Status of the workload.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp of the workload.
- `domains` (List of String) List of domains associated with the workload.
- `id` (Number) The workload identifier.
- `infrastructure` (Number) Infrastructure type: 1 for Production (All Locations), 2 for Staging.
- `last_editor` (String) The last editor of the workload.
- `last_modified` (String) Last modified timestamp of the workload.
- `mtls` (Attributes) Mutual TLS configuration for the workload. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--mtls))
- `name` (String) Name of the workload.
- `product_version` (String) Product version of the workload.
- `protocols` (Attributes) Protocol configurations for the workload. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--protocols))
- `tls` (Attributes) TLS configuration for the workload. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--tls))
- `workload_domain` (String) The workload domain.
- `workload_domain_allow_access` (Boolean) Whether domain access is allowed.

<a id="nestedatt--results--mtls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.mtls`

Read-Only:

- `config` (Attributes) MTLS configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--mtls--config))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether MTLS is enabled.

<a id="nestedatt--results--mtls--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.mtls.config`

Read-Only:

- `certificate` (Number) MTLS certificate ID.
- `crl` (List of Number) Certificate Revocation List.
- `verification` (String) MTLS verification type: enforce or permissive.



<a id="nestedatt--results--protocols"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.protocols`

Read-Only:

- `http` (Attributes) HTTP protocol configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--protocols--http))

<a id="nestedatt--results--protocols--http"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.protocols.http`

Read-Only:

- `http_ports` (List of Number) HTTP ports.
- `https_ports` (List of Number) HTTPS ports.
- `quic_ports` (List of Number) QUIC ports.
- `versions` (List of String) HTTP versions supported.



<a id="nestedatt--results--tls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.tls`

Read-Only:

- `certificate` (Number) Certificate ID for TLS.
- `ciphers` (Number) Cipher suite configuration.
- `minimum_version` (String) Minimum TLS version.
